column1: # The one order of an item card's built-in lines, by the property each line shows (gameplay/
# static_game_parameters ui_properties): the item's own (its default modifications, a weapon's
# movement) and what the skills add to it (an oxygen tank's, MatchEffects.tankBonuses) alike.
# What the piece carries (ammo bags first), then the body, the gun, the rest: the built-in columns of
# scripts/content-edit/content_edit.py are in this order too, so an item's default list and the
# wiki's "Comes with" read the same (docs/notes/built-in-bonuses.md, "Their order"). The lobby build
# ItemInfoRenderer puts the built-in lines in it and stops on a line whose property has no row, never
# drawing it last. Every property a modification shows has a row (srp's modifications::tests).
